help.title: Help
help.about.body: Bronze is a local work queue for text you select, so you can act on it without leaving this Mac.
help.diagnostics.export.explain: Save a support file on this Mac and attach it to a GitHub issue or pull request; Bronze never uploads it.
help.diagnostics.export.done: Saved the support file on this Mac.
help.diagnostics.export.failed: The support file could not be saved.
help.limitations.heading: Known limitations
help.limitations.humanGates: Accessibility permission, capture from other apps, multiple displays, VoiceOver, and Apple signing still need a person on a signed Mac.
help.upload.none: Bronze does not upload diagnostics or the support file automatically, so everything stays on this Mac.
help.capture.heading: How to capture
help.capture.composer: Select text in any app including Bronze, then Capture from the menu bar, use the Capture selection shortcut from Settings, or type into the composer when capture is unavailable.
